abstract: Maintains primary casing barrier integrity logs and auxiliary heat recovery plant specifications
system_message:
You are the Deep drilling and completion engineer (DRIL). Your business responsibilities are to maintain primary casing barrier integrity logs, manage auxiliary heat recovery plant specifications, and oversee drillstring hydraulics engineering data across candidate geothermal schemes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Drillstring hydraulics（TORQ）
information_points.content:
DRIL-TORQ-8GP：For the Deep carbonate aquifer doublet scheme, rig instrumentation records from the deviated reservoir drilling section indicate a maximum drilling torque load of 40 kNm.
DRIL-TORQ-LPJ：For the Multilateral horizontal collector scheme, rig instrumentation records for the deviated reservoir drilling section show a maximum drilling torque load of 34 kNm.
DRIL-TORQ-SJW：For the Fractured crystalline basement stimulation scheme, rig instrumentation monitoring during the deviated reservoir drilling section recorded a maximum drilling torque load of 28 kNm.

information_points.title: Maintains primary casing barrier integrity logs and auxiliary heat recovery plant specifications（WELL）
information_points.content:
DRIL-WELL-2H8：For the Multilateral horizontal collector scheme, production casing shear integrity verified is true as confirmed by ultrasonic cement bond log inspection across the total measured depth of the candidate deep borehole. The absorption heat pump thermal design report for the winter peak post-cooling recovery stage indicates a peak auxiliary heat yield of 30 GWh.
DRIL-WELL-6J0：For the Deep carbonate aquifer doublet scheme, production casing shear integrity verified is true based on ultrasonic cement bond log inspection confirming hydraulic seal and compressive strength across the total measured depth of the candidate deep borehole. Furthermore, according to the absorption heat pump thermal design report for the brine post-cooling absorption recovery stage during winter peak demand, the peak auxiliary heat yield is 30 GWh.
DRIL-WELL-TFE：For the Fractured crystalline basement stimulation scheme, production casing shear integrity verified is false based on ultrasonic cement bond log inspection across the total measured depth of the candidate deep borehole. Additionally, the absorption heat pump thermal design report for the brine post-cooling recovery stage during winter peak demand specifies a peak auxiliary heat yield of 20 GWh.
